description: This Kotlin source file defines the DbAppChecker class, which manages app update and issue checking logic within an Android-based FDroid client. It interacts with database DAOs, package manager, and update/compatibility checkers to determine app statuses such as updates, vulnerabilities, and compatibility issues.

classes.name: DbAppChecker
classes.description: Main class responsible for checking app statuses, updates, and issues in the FDroid client.

methods.name: getApps
methods.description: Analyzes installed apps and their versions to determine which are updatable, unavailable, have issues like vulnerabilities or signer incompatibilities, and returns a comprehensive result.

methods.name: getUnavailableApp
methods.description: Checks if an app was previously installed by the user and is now unavailable, returning an issue report if so.

methods.name: getNoCompatibleSignerApp
methods.description: Determines if an app has updates with incompatible signers across repositories, indicating signer issues.

methods.name: Version.isOk
methods.description: Checks if a version is from the preferred repo, not vulnerable, and has compatible signers.

methods.name: getUpdatableApp
methods.description: Constructs an UpdatableApp object if an update is available and suitable.
